The outcome of the war is yet unknown, but it promises to be a new kind of warfare—both sides possess the recently invented railroad, telegraph, and repeating rifle. It is well known that $CB_TARGET_NAME$ is plotting to invade us. It is only a matter of time before they attack, and we must strike first. Fortunately, a recent pamphlet detailing their nefarious plans has been widely printed, and angry citizens have rallied to our banner.

It is extremely embarrassing that several of our soldiers were caught while infiltrating $CB_TARGET_NAME$ territory wearing their uniforms. There are rumors they were sent to provoke border disputes to legalize our invasion. It is best not to add fuel to the fire now.

The people have long suffered under the brutal rule of $CB_TARGET_NAME$. For the well-being of the masses, we must expose the brutal rule of $CB_TARGET_NAME$ to the world and bring the people in their sphere of influence under our protection for mutual prosperity.
Despite presenting ample evidence of the brutal rule of $CB_TARGET_NAME$, it appears that neither international opinion nor the Great Powers support our efforts to rescue those oppressed nations.

Without the protection of a Great Power like us, $CB_TARGET_NAME$ is very insecure. To protect them, we will bring them into our sphere of influence, though they may foolishly resist in the short term. After all, if they were wise, they would already be a great power.

Although we only sought to bring $CB_TARGET_NAME$ into our sphere of influence to protect them, they have repaid our kindness with hostility. The international situation is turning against us, and world opinion opposes our actions.

Why does $CB_TARGET_NAME$ get all the rich colonies? This is very unfair! They may not even be properly exploiting, or educating, the indigenous peoples! We must do something—we want a place in the sun!

Although we have presented legitimate demands with humility, international opinion still does not support restoring the colonial balance between our nation and $CB_TARGET_NAME$. Though this is a setback, we firmly believe we will one day succeed in building an empire where the sun never sets.
